blocks.text: The power menu provides locking, logout and power actions. Power Profile selects among the modes available on the installed hardware. Idle inhibition and screen locking have separate controls; confirm the current state in their menus.

items: Save documents and stop long operations through their owning application.
Disconnect remote shares and removable media only after closing files.
Let package operations finish. The managed sleep guard protects active package work.
Use the normal Power action and wait for completion.

blocks.text: For repeated suspend/resume failures, record the selected profile, attached hardware and time, then inspect boot logs. Hardware tuning settings are host gated; do not copy tuning flags from another machine.
